描述_EN: square bordered on the sides, on a dark blue background, with a scalloped ecru stripe motif on the long sides, set between two ecru fillets. fragment of canvas with fragmentary tapestry square, added by sewing on a linen canvas, with ecru decoration on a dark blue background. The center of the square is decorated with a small, plain dark blue border, followed by a regular network of small, adjacent rhombuses, created with a shuttle. The contours of these rhombuses are drawn with two lines, the outer line being thicker than the inner line. these delimit a square space at the corners, at the center of which is an unbleached Greek cross.
描述_ZN: carré边框，深蓝色背景，长边上有一个扇形的ecru条纹图案，镶嵌在两个ecru丝之间。 帆布碎片，有零星的挂毯方块，是在亚麻布上缝制添加的，深蓝色的背景上有乌黑的装饰。 方块的中心装饰有一个小的普通深蓝色边框，随后是一个有规律的相邻的小菱形网络，用梭子制作，其轮廓用两条线画出，外线比内线粗。 这些标志着一个正方形空间的角落，其中心是一个未漂白的希腊十字架。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
